description: This Java class 'LogDownloader' provides a GUI component for uploading and managing log files from an ECU, including listing, deleting, and downloading log files.

classes.name: LogDownloader
classes.description: A GUI component for managing log files from ECU, including listing, deleting, and downloading logs.

methods.name: LogDownloader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the log downloader UI and message listener.

methods.name: createFilePanel
methods.description: Creates a panel representing a log file with delete and download options.

methods.name: resetLogsList
methods.description: Clears the list of displayed log files.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Displays the UI components and initiates directory listing.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Sends command to list log files in directory.
